title: FinCEN investigates unauthorized access to its systems
content_md:
FinCEN investigates unauthorized access to its systems. The agency is looking into unauthorized access to part of its systems and removed some of them.

via Mastodon https://guiadeti.com.br/noticias/fincen-investiga-incidente-ciberseguranca-acesso-nao-autorizado/
exclude_reason: Mastodon repost of a short Brazilian news brief about a FinCEN access incident; no corroborating feed coverage or primary detail, social-only rumor-level item
